raw: I felt proud when my homemade kite finally stayed in the air. I’d made it myself, so it mattered to me that it actually flew. At first I was watching it and thinking, “Is it going to stay up this time?” Then it kept flying, and I could just enjoy it instead of waiting for it to come down. That was the part that felt good—looking up and thinking, “I made that.” It was a simple thing, but I was really pleased with it.
